function.name: import_vault_file
function.description: Copies a file on your machine into a vault exactly as it is, binary files included, creating missing folders: a new file, the next version of the file at path, or a file added to the artifact path runs into. When path ends in ".artifact", the file must be a .artifact file and makes that artifact or its next version. A zip stays a zip file; make an artifact from one with write_vault_artifact. Files up to 512 MiB. To copy within or between vaults, use copy_vault_file.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

path.description: Where it goes in the vault, including its name
